name: Link

guidance.useFor: Going somewhere: another page, a section of this one, a file.
insteadUse: Doing something on the page: Button
content: Link text says where it goes and makes sense alone: "Delivery times", never "click here"
Say when a link opens a new tab or downloads a file

rungReason: <a href> gives the link role, Enter activation, history, the context menu and visited state; the class only draws it.

a11y.name: Its text; an icon-only link needs aria-label
a11y.targetSize: Inline links are exempt from WCAG 2.5.8; links on their own sit in a row at least --lue-size-target-min

react.note: A router's link takes className="lue-link" instead

rules: Underlined always, in running text and alone: colour is never the only cue (WCAG 1.4.1)
--lue-color-fg-accent holds 4.5:1 on canvas, surfaces, glass and satin (token build gate)
contrast: The accent text token is raised in the -more themes
forcedColors: LinkText from the browser; the underline stays
